cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Escape the ordinary and delve into a world of creativity during this Wild Clay Pottery Workshop. We'll work together amidst the breathtaking beauty of nature on private property in Julian, California. This immersive experience invites travelers to unleash their artistic spirits (no experience necessary) against a backdrop of rolling, oak-strewn hills and apple orchards. Discover the timeless art of pottery-making guided by expert artisan, Becky Sangha, as you mold and shape clay sourced from the very earth beneath your feet. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned potter, our workshop promises an unforgettable journey of self-expression and connection with the land. Book your spot today and indulge in a truly enriching adventure in the mountains here in Julian, where artistry meets nature in perfect harmony.
